label: Enrollments by Course
description: Enrollment count grouped by the internal course ID (not the course name) - this frozen KPI's SQL template can only reference canonical roles bound on the fact table, so it can't express a joined, human-readable label generically across customers. Prefer query_metric/list_metrics for a course-name breakdown, which resolves real per-customer joins (P2-07).
sql: SELECT {{course_ref}} AS course, COUNT(*) AS enrollment_count FROM {{fact}} GROUP BY {{course_ref}} ORDER BY enrollment_count DESC
